askAll.question: Where does the Acme deal stand?

sentences.text: In the Acme renewal call, Dana said Acme had closed a Series B, was growing to about 120 seats, and had pricing pushback at $65 per seat with a year-one target under $90K; she said a two-year term could work.

Security review is also in progress: Marcus the new CISO will review the vendor, Okta SSO is required, the SOC 2 Type II report is ready, and a security call was set for Tuesday; the contract ends on the 30th, and Dana wants to sign before then.

askAll.question: Who is blocked, and on what?
